analysis: The PR changes only docs/provider/two-mac-cluster.md. It updates the date (line 3), adds a tensor-parallel model table and a Gemma 4 placement explanation (head lines 337-353), and the patch excerpt shows an edit near the SSD-precision/prefix-cache text (head ~487-490). No code, keys, attestation, authorization, or encryption behavior changes. The added text describes planner behavior: Gemma 4 text-only, logprobs in TP only, `DARKBLOOM_CLUSTER_BATCH_LANES` as an operator env knob, and Qwen3.8 27B media in TP only. These are documentation statements about runtime behavior I cannot verify here, since the planner and inference.md anchors are outside the supplied evidence. They do not weaken any threat-model control. The prefix-cache text (base lines 464-504) still describes per-tenant scoping, an encrypted SSD tier, and both Macs needing the same precision. It is consistent with T-041 (cache scope coordinator-authored; SSD at-rest encrypted; accepted SEC-035). The head excerpt for the prefix-cache section was truncated at line 453, so I could not fully inspect the changed lines at 487-490 on the head side. The patch suggests the change is only to the toml/precision wording and is not security-relevant. Remaining integration question: whether the doc's claim about the Gemma TP path is backed by code in the same PR, for example the cache scoping or media refusal for Gemma. That is outside this docs-only batch. No new attack surface or invalidated threat assumptions identified.
